record_type: minimal publication projection of the author research state; not a service log or a prospective benchmark
selection: All candidate IDs matching (REE|OAE)-R[1-8]-0[1-3]; no candidate omitted

candidates.question: Can the apparent difference in timing of carbonate loss and ecological recovery between U1513 and U1516 be distinguished from age-model, hiatus and splice uncertainty?
Do peak radiolarian concentrations indicate greater production, or can carbonate loss and dilution explain them?
Can laboratory/method effects account for the suppression of the bulk-carbonate carbon-isotope excursion at U1513, separate from preservation and true local carbon cycling?
Interface versus burial control of phosphate-hosted REY enrichment
Could extraction selectivity and mass closure change carrier interpretation?
Can hydrothermal Fe-Mn-P supply be distinguished from organic matter and carbonate dilution controls?
Sensitivity of S57 recovery Mo intensity interpretation to explicitly conditional carbonate mass-basis scenarios
Can host-adjusted Hg distinguish external OAE2 input from local preservation?
Does reduced P recycling require redox change after carbonate and burial adjustment?
Under what sample-support and endmember-separation conditions do paired bottom-water, porewater and authigenic εNd constrain recycled versus new sedimentary Nd?
Can constant carrier-phase proportions alone identify the timing of REY uptake?
Can filtration and pooled sample support alter an Nd proxy reliability classification independently of geochemical differences?
Do the published phase-III Cismon Rb/Sr and Mn/Ti cutoffs retain their conditional discrimination across complete post-event cycles, or is state history required?

Can fixed-denudation oxidative weathering enhancement compatible with the published Re-isotope interpretation also satisfy the early-CIE shale Re and carbonate-U constraints under explicitly bounded burial and duration scenarios?
Can measured bulk-metal inventory alone explain metal-specific porphyrin partitioning and recovery, or are formation/preservation changes also required?
What retained initial Nd inventory is necessary for the measured fossil-tooth tip isotope offset to carry a biological living-water signal, when concentration and isotope laser supports differ?
Can observed tooth-size distributions and sediment sorting constrain the fraction of net REY enrichment that can be generated by local winnowing versus persistent allochthonous particle supply?

Do early-Eocene tooth-rich layers show increased fish skeletal production or a changed skeletal size/mass spectrum and sediment dilution, when counts are compared with phosphate inventory without relying on disputed Os ages?

At Barranco de la Cañada, does the published return of mean log shell size correspond to restoration of the pre-event individual size distribution, or can taxonomic replacement and changed relative abundance restore the mean while distribution shape remains outside ordinary pre-event bed-to-bed variation?

Within consistent Cleveland Basin bulk-sampling series, what fraction of the return of benthic modes is carried by pre-event resident taxa versus taxa first observed after the event, and does apparent restoration of modes mask persistent replacement of the contributing taxa?

Can compound-specific carbon and source-composition measurements bound how much of the early bulk-carbon excursion records source mixing versus change in the background carbon reservoir, before the later productivity/anoxia response?
Does the nitrate/Fe-clay redox transition focus or disperse the dissolved REY flux in abyssal sediments, and how much element-selective diffusive convergence occurs across the transition?

What is the molar Nd-to-orthophosphate ratio of benthic diffusive exchange at oxic abyssal sediment interfaces, and can independent source/sink constraints distinguish nutrient regeneration from mineral desorption?

How does size-selective separation alter the elemental composition of the retained and returned REY inventory, and can contrasting fine-phosphate versus coarse-bioapatite assemblages explain reversal of element-selective recovery?

Among externally calibratable bivalve species observed in Iberia during Tenuicostatum, does older other-region thermal affinity distinguish Exaratum detection from non-detection, and in which supported population is that association transferable?

Do same-sample B/C/O isotopes, carbonate leachate element measurements and detrital/mineral observations identify an acidification signal rather than composition or alteration effects at two Iberian-margin sections?

Can independent same-sample source and preservation observations quantify whether spatial OCAR differences reflect hydrological accommodation or changing autochthonous versus land-derived carbon inputs?

Do contrasting operational P-bearing phases carry different molar REY loads per mole P, and does the phase-load contrast persist between two Indian Ocean cores after separating phosphate quantity from phosphate chemistry?

Does the measurable dissolved Ce component exchange across the oxic abyssal sediment-water interface with the same relative efficiency as its trivalent REE neighbors, or is there a selective interfacial retention term?

Does morphological position within an individual fossil fish tooth impose a repeatable element-selective uptake contrast, distinct from core/depth differences, that changes the composition expected from selective preservation of tooth parts?

Within the non-focal UC11 biostratigraphic interval broadly containing Micula acmes2/3, do named background genera show a reproducible cross-site redistribution beyond pure focal-genus expansion and ordinary local temporal variation?

Do species-resolved paired Ca isotope and shell dimension observations require a within-lineage calcification response before the Aptian–Albian turnover, or can the planktic signal be explained by replacement/mixing plus the shared seawater background?

Beyond the already published mean cooling and seawater isotope trajectory, did among-shell hydroclimatic variability change across fixed OAE2/PCE phases, and can independent shell replicates distinguish real heterogeneity from analytical and pooling uncertainty?

Can a single, fixed-composition non-lithogenic particle assemblage account simultaneously for mesopelagic REY and remineralization-associated Ba profiles at GEOVIDE, after lithogenic mixing and measurement uncertainty, and what directly measured inventory contrast remains if it cannot?

In the Kairei plume, can the dissolved REY deficit be accounted for by redistribution into the measured 0.2–0.8 micrometre pool, or is a nonzero minimum transfer out of the entire <0.8 micrometre pool required?

During low-temperature alteration of Cretaceous seafloor basalt, how does net elemental REY gain/loss per original rock mass covary with alkalinity-generating major-element transfer, after accounting for alteration-related mass change?

Under an explicit local retained-inventory-to-burial-endmember mapping, can the published organic-S isotope value of -7 per mil and organic/pyrite S flux ratios of 3 or 6 represent the actual paired sulfur pools in the four Raven2019 records, and which parameter governs any material mismatch?

Do the Gongzha and Iona-1 records contain independent source-resolving measurements sufficient to constrain hydrothermal versus benthic iron supply, beyond their published detrital and local-process corrections?

Does the new Oued Kharroub individual-level Watznaueria record distinguish proportional coccolith shrinkage from a change in internal/external geometry or population structure, beyond the already published mean-size decrease?
Can a surface-area-normalized goethite sorption response predict the pH-dependent REY retention of independent deep-Pacific sediment batches, or is a second reactive surface required?

Within individual deep-sea hydrothermal vent orifices, do bottle-level REY concentrations follow independently constrained seawater mixing, or do element-selective reaction losses occur during fluid collection/cooling?
Can silicate dissolution progress predict net dissolved REY delivery consistently across silicic and basaltic river-particle incubations, or does secondary uptake reverse the supply relationship?
Do successive independently delimited OAE1b repopulation intervals repeatedly recover the broader benthic assemblage, or only the already known opportunistic colonizers?
Do paired small and conventional size fractions distinguish a hidden small-bodied surviving community from true decline of benthic and heterohelicid populations?

Within independent ash/allostratigraphic windows, do spatial differences in organic-carbon concentration correspond to differences in preserved carbon inventory, or mainly to sediment dilution and incomplete stratigraphic representation?

Does the fixed Lin–Catling seawater REE–pH calibration transfer to independently collected, matched-bottle GP15 observations at its original 200–800 m, 100 m layer scale, and does it add predictive information beyond the original depth-layer pH means?

Can the excess dissolved REE retention in a replicated phytoplankton bloom be separated quantitatively from an abiotic wall/oxide sink, yielding a demonstrably new mass-balance constraint on biogenic recycling?

Does a stable lanthanide demand per methane oxidized transfer from four independent deep-seep incubations to a field methanotrophic plume, or do storage/regeneration and nonbiological uptake create a different apparent demand?

interpretation: 48 screened candidate questions in eight rounds, one advanced to drafting and a delivered research manuscript. Six not-selected candidates remain distinct from rejection. This does not establish 48 completed analyses, 48 independent discoveries, journal acceptance, or the counterfactual benefit of DeepShovel.
